item.title: Portfolio
item.description:
I write documentation that helps people use software and developers build with it. These samples include help articles, integration guides, API and SDK references, and technical explainers.

I focus on making complex products easier to understand and adopt, with documentation that stays accurate and maintainable as products grow.

item.title: Resume
item.description:
I’m a senior technical writer with 10+ years of experience documenting complex software products, from end-user guides to API and SDK documentation. I also build the information architecture, standards, and workflows that help documentation grow with a product. I work with product, design, engineering, and support to get documentation ready for launch and use feedback from users to improve it.

AI tools help me update content efficiently, while I review the results for consistency with established style guides.
